findings.title: Load balancer target group uses plain HTTP
findings.description: A target group with protocol = "HTTP" forwards traffic to targets unencrypted, exposing internal traffic on the network. Use HTTPS for backend connections.
findings.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Replace HTTP listeners with HTTPS, set a modern TLS policy (e.g. `ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06`), and redirect HTTP→HTTPS. Disable weak ciphers and old protocol versions everywhere.

findings.title: Load balancer target group using plaintext HTTP
findings.description: A load balancer target group with protocol = "HTTP" forwards traffic to targets unencrypted inside the VPC, exposing request data and credentials to network sniffing. Use HTTPS with valid target certificates.
findings.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Replace HTTP listeners with HTTPS, set a modern TLS policy (e.g. `ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06`), and redirect HTTP→HTTPS. Disable weak ciphers and old protocol versions everywhere.
